posts.cooked:
There should be a story where Fanatic, the most judgmental of heroes, runs a foul of Judge Mental.

Apparently C&A have forgotten that podcasts started with the original iPod all the way back in like Y2K or Space Odyssey. They still mostly exist, though they would likely be nigh impossible to find anymore. But there were other new ones at around the time they speak of; the Cracked podcast, for instance, ran from late 2013 or 14 until mid 2017, so claiming that there were no podcasts in 2013 is pretty thoroughly untrue.
